pages.title: Baird's Tapir
pages.text: Baird's tapir ($(o)Tapirus bairdii$()) is a tapir found in the forests and wetlands of Central America, from southern Mexico to northwestern Colombia.$(br2)It is the largest native land mammal of Central America, and the national animal of Belize.$(br2)Baird's tapirs are herbivores that browse on leaves and fruit and often wallow in water. The species is listed as Endangered.
